description: POST /api/msd/write and POST /api/msd/write_remote against kvmd 4.186, recorded by hand: the capture tool only records GETs, and both of these change device state. write_remote answers HTTP 200 with an application/x-ndjson body, one envelope per line, so its failures arrive inside a 200 rather than as a status.
safety: Both endpoints write to the device. This was recorded with the MSD temporarily enabled in the OTG profile (see README) against a throttled HTTP origin running on the device's own loopback, serving generated zeros -- nothing was fetched from the internet, and the sanitizer rewrote the origin's own address where kvmd echoed it. Every image written here was removed afterwards and the OTG profile restored. Re-recording it means changing somebody's device, so ask first.

steps.name: remote_ok
steps.note: the whole NDJSON body of a download that succeeded: one record before the first byte, one about every second while it runs, one when it ends. The origin was a throttled server on the device's own loopback, serving 4 MiB of zeros

steps.name: remote_exists
steps.note: kvmd refuses before it streams anything, so this failure is an ordinary status and not an NDJSON record

steps.name: remote_broken
steps.note: the origin announced 4 MiB and closed after 256 KiB: kvmd writes the failure as the last NDJSON record and then lets the exception escape the handler, so the chunked body never gets its final chunk and the connection breaks under HTTP 200

steps.name: remote_no_length
steps.note: a chunked origin: kvmd sizes the image from the remote Content-Length and refuses without one

steps.name: remote_unreachable
steps.note: nothing listening on the port; timeout is what bounds this

result.error_msg: Cannot connect to host localhost:1 ssl:default [Multiple exceptions: [Errno 111] Connect call failed ('::1', 1, 0, 0), [Errno 111] Connect call failed ('192.0.2.10', 1)]

steps.name: remote_bad_scheme
steps.note: the URL validator runs before anything is fetched

result.error_msg: The argument 'ftp://localhost/image.iso' is not a valid HTTPS|HTTP URL

steps.name: remote_no_url
steps.note: url is the one required parameter

result.error_msg: None argument is not a valid HTTPS|HTTP URL

steps.name: write_ok
steps.note: the write info aiopikvm used to discard

steps.name: write_prefix
steps.note: prefix is joined onto the name server-side, so the image kvmd stored is not the name that was sent

steps.name: write_prefix_missing_dir
steps.note: the same call into a subdirectory that does not exist yet: kvmd writes its .incomplete marker before it creates the directory, so this is an unhandled FileNotFoundError rather than an API error
steps.body_text:
500 Internal Server Error

Server got itself in trouble

steps.name: write_chunked
steps.note: no Content-Length, because httpx frames an iterator as Transfer-Encoding: chunked; kvmd sizes the image from that header alone

result.error_msg: None argument is not a valid int

steps.name: write_no_image
steps.note: image is required, and the empty name fails the same validator a path traversal would

result.error_msg: The argument '/' is not a valid MSD image name
